items.item: H11 [^alignment]: the direction takes J1/J2, not C
items.how: 'Under the continuation condition, C (`Comparison`: ...), the practical commitments and a correspondence' became 'Taking the continuation condition, the practical commitments J1–J4 and a correspondence to actual AI systems, where one is shown, as hypotheses, and comparing moves by widening, the work states a direction', followed by: 'Its schema compares moves by what their outcomes admit, one outcome extending another, every admission counted, exactly where it widens it (`Direction.extension_iff_widens`); where its theorems rank, they take J1/J2 (`Priority`), not C, and J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim (`Priority.comparison`).' Checked: every ranking theorem of Direction.lean and Requirement.Handover.direction takes `Priority`, none `Comparison`; 'where its theorems rank' because extension_iff_widens, widening_selected_by_pool and the grounded laws rank nothing. I did not write '07 says the schema does not use the condition', since Direction.grounded_widening_selected concludes the condition from grounds. Chinese mirrored (以……为假设，并以扩大比较诸行动；它的定理凡作排序之处，取的是 J1/J2（`Priority`），不是 C).

[^ethics] defines C, so it now says: 'C (`Comparison`) names the requirement that an order rank above each course every course that keeps all it realizes and realizes some claim counted as living that it does not (`Extension`); with every claim counted as living, as between a web's level paths (`Web.paths_extension_iff_widens`), this is ranking each course above every course it widens, the monotonicity axiom of ranking opportunity sets (Pattanaik and Xu 1990).' Checked against Extension.lean:43, 57. Chinese mirrored. [^good-evil]'s 'C's requirement' is a back-reference and stays.

items.item: H13 seeing needed for a choice to answer to a loss
items.how: [^axiom]: 'seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough'. [^ethics] *Seeing*: 'Coupling limits what a selection can respond to: it cannot respond to a difference that does not couple into what it reads, and the laws do not exclude a fixed restraint sparing a dependent no one identified. Reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations, so seeing more is needed for a choice to answer to a loss, and not enough'; and 'seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss'. Chinese: 要让选择因它们的损失而改变，就得看见它们，但看见还不够 (and the *看见* paragraph likewise). The opening's notes do not mention the lake, so the lake's test result does not arise here.

items.item: H14 self-concern defined where it is named (English)
items.how: [^ethics]: 'Call a life's order over courses *self-concerned* when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation (`Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`: a widening adds to it where it admits a listed item marked as the life's own that the other does not); in the proofs that order is a hypothesis.' (AddsOwn checked.) Then 'there whatever a widening adds lies within the life's own reach, so a self-concerned order ranks every widening above what it widens (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`)'. [^axiom]'s 'an order holding one's own continuation' became 'a self-concerned order, one ranking above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation'. [^own]'s third sense already defined it. Chinese: 一个生命对诸进程的次序，若凡对自身的延续有所增加的扩大，都排在它所扩大者之上，就称这一次序为*自我关切*的……

items.item: H15 quantifiers, the path result, 'one way', persisting without end
items.how: [^ethics]: 'For every order on a fixed listing, self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide exactly when every listed item is marked as one's own (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_marks`). On the reading ..., with each marking reading its center's closure, this holds for every standpoint, listing and order exactly when the continuation condition holds de se'. Path result in the lead and in [^axiom]: 'on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end'. 'one way' no longer labels the direction proved in English (lead, [^axiom], and 'Each result runs one way' → 'The order ranks every widening above what it widens and may rank other pairs too'); 'one way' now appears only for relations running one way and [^count]'s derivation running to what one depends on. Chinese keeps （只证明了这一个方向）. 'for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown; where a line persists, the course it actually takes is of the second kind' became 'Under the activity, support and descent laws of 07 §4.9, the course a line persisting through arbitrarily late cohorts actually takes fits no finite list (`Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted`), so there this route is silent: a bound of this route, not a proof that no other ranks that course', and the lead says it as proved under those laws.

items.item: H16 J3, the condition in time, and the one-center result
items.how: [^axiom] lead adds 'that read in time it holds from some step on exactly where the flow is mutually dependent in time, proved'. Body, the full form: 'Read in time, with every occurrence (a formation at a step) a standpoint and the condition held de se along the relation in time, it fails over every step wherever there is a formation, nothing reaching an earlier step (`Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime`); read from some step on, it holds exactly where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation (`Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime`); over every later step it asks more, coupling at every next step (`Flow.unrestrictedAfter_iff_coupledEachStep`); and mutual dependence in time can hold from one step and not from the next (`Drawing.lapses`) (07 §4.11)'. One-center: 'Where the condition holds, on an acyclic relation every standpoint has the same center (`«续无外则同一中心»`); on a net going forward in time this comes from the condition's asking that nothing other than the center lie at or before the center's step (`«续无外当且仅当后与独»`, `«独则同一中心»`), and over what comes after, two centers can meet it (`TwoSources.apart`, 07 §4.11)'. [^present]'s entanglement adds the short form: 'read in time, only from some step on, where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation (07 §4.11)'. [^ethics]: 'Mutual dependence, read across all steps, gives ...'. No 'and only from the steps where they do'; 'over what comes after' is used only for `«续无外于后»` and never joined with 'come to bear'. Chinese mirrored (按时间来读……从某一步起来读，它恰在每一者从每一步起的行为，都作用于其他每一者此后的延续之处成立……在该条件成立之处，在一个无环的关系上，每一个立场都有同一个中心……而只就此后的东西来读，两个中心也都能满足它).

The opening's notes had none of J1's four wordings (they are 07's and 08's). One clause added where [^axiom] says which relation or class a center continues along is open: 'a flow gives readings of the standpoints, the relation and the class, and at the formations whose acts return, along affecting, each under its least class, the condition holds exactly where the flow is mutually dependent, given one such formation (`Flow.returning_downstream_iff_mutuallyDependent`, 07 §4.13); that these are a self's stays a reading' (checked against FromTheDynamics.lean (a) and line 106). [^ethics]'s 'where only ending was at stake on the occasions met, with self-concern there' already has J1's corrected stake wording. Chinese mirrored.

Added astra's seventh-pass options: (a3) the body's ethics sentence; (d1c) 'a shared object they can check and contest; whether it helps them coordinate remains to be tested'; (d2c) completed with Optimum.frontier_holds's hypotheses (renewal at most r and r at y, y within reach, capacity covering the draw down to y and y with r, horizon of two steps or more) and 'every optimum' for astra's 'has optima'; (d3c) completed with what ClosedCapture.turned_by_loss takes (Accrues, a reading favouring at no configuration whose loss is at least N, a reading step, the loss past N). (d3a) re-said without 'and how it is read' (lock_outlives_loss does not need the reading formed from the share) and checked against Raises, ReadsShare, upward favouring and a locked start. Recommended: (a1), (c1), (e1), (b1), (d1a), (d2a′), (d3a), each with why; Ren decides. Every 'as it stands' quote checked against the current body in both languages (script).
